name: canvasmith
description: A Photoshop-grade image editor that opens right inside your Claude conversation.
long_description:
Canvasmith puts a full layered image editor inside Claude. Ask Claude to open a photo from your computer or the web, or to start a blank canvas, and edit it in the conversation with layers, brush, magic wand and lasso selections, crop, text, shapes, gradients, fills, filters and adjustment layers.

Exports are saved to a folder you choose (Pictures/Canvasmith by default), and a preview is shared back so Claude can see what you made. Use **Send to Claude** to post the edited image into the chat.

Everything runs locally: images are read from and written to your own disk, and nothing is uploaded to a Canvasmith server. Smart (OpenCV) selection loads its library from cdn.jsdelivr.net the first time you use it.

tools.name: open_canvasmith
tools.description: Open the Canvasmith image editor inline, on a local image, an image URL, or a blank canvas.
